title: Free time, culture and the media
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a szabadidődről, a kulturális programokról, az olvasásról és a médiáról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: How do you usually spend your free time, and has this changed in the last few years?
Do you think teenagers today have enough free time? Why or why not?
What was the last cultural event you went to, for example a concert, an exhibition or a play?
Do you prefer reading books on paper or on a screen? Why?
How do you decide which films or series to watch?
Where do you get your news from, and how do you know if it's reliable?
followUps: Have you ever believed a piece of fake news?

questions.q: Is it important for young people to go to the theatre or to museums? Why?
Which sport do you enjoy most, either playing or watching? Why?
How has the internet changed the way people spend their free time?
If you had a whole week off with no obligations, how would you spend it?
